requirements.text: The system shall ensure accurate recording of transactions to prevent data loss and maintain integrity.
The system shall maintain an immutable audit trail of all transactions for a minimum of 7 years.
The system shall implement user access controls that combine role-based permissions with user-specific permissions.
The system shall provide mechanisms to detect and alert users about potential financial discrepancies or fraud.
The system shall ensure compliance with applicable financial regulations and standards.
The system shall ensure that all financial transactions are processed within 3 seconds.
The system shall validate currency conversions to prevent financial discrepancies.
The system shall implement energy-efficient algorithms to minimize energy consumption during processing.
The system shall provide functionalities for users to report ethical concerns or violations confidentially.
The system shall generate financial reports in under 5 seconds for datasets up to 10,000 transactions.
The system shall support multi-currency transactions with transparent exchange rates.
